source_title: Ten rules for external sector stress - Business Standard
source_excerpt: There is considerable stress in the Indian external sector. Policymakers see information that we, as external persons, do not. From the outside, it is not useful to comment on the minutiae of tactical policy moves. Drawing on the experiences of crises in the Indian external sector over the past 25 years, we offer 10 principles that are universally useful in understanding the present situation and responding to it.
